bio:
Mother of Savino Giannetta per Bisaccia Matrimoni 1867 act 17. The transcriber marked the surname 'Macchia(?)' as an uncertain reading of 19th-century handwriting.

The FamilySearch tree spells her surname Macchia, matching Round 3's tentative reading 'Macchia(?)' in the 1867 act ([R4-S1]). It gives her birth as 8 Apr 1812 and her death as 9 May 1880 in Bisaccia, and names her parents as Nicola Macchia (c.1782–1817) and Grazia Maria Gallicchio (c.1785–1855) ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]). Widowed in 1848, she remarried Donato Sena on 28 Sep 1850. One FS source is a FamilySearch-indexed Avellino record (ark 1:1:6J4L-ZFYY) that groups her with Savino, Angelamaria Fede and 'Francesco': this is the 1867 marriage act of her son.
